units.source_text: 源氏终于从二条院回到了六条院本邸。

en.t: Genji finally returned from the Nijo residence to the main Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 春色渐深，庭前景色无异昔时。

en.t: Spring had deepened, and the view before the garden was no different from former days.

units.source_text: 他并不惜春，但觉情绪异常不宁。

en.t: He was not grieving for spring, yet his feelings were strangely unsettled.

units.source_text: 一切见闻，无不使他伤心。

en.t: Everything he saw and heard brought him sorrow.

units.source_text: 这六条院似乎变成了另一世界。

en.t: The Rokujo estate seemed to have become another world.

units.source_text: 他所向往的，只是鸟声也听不到的深山，道心与日俱增。

en.t: What he longed for was only the deep mountains where even birdsong could not be heard, and his religious resolve grew stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 棣棠花开满枝头，嫩黄悦目，源氏一看便流下泪来，

en.t: Kerria blossoms filled the branches, their fresh yellow pleasing to the eye, and as soon as Genji saw them, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 只觉得触目伤心。

en.t: He felt only that everything before his eyes wounded his heart.

units.source_text: 别处的花，这边一重樱谢了，那边八重樱盛开；

en.t: Elsewhere, when the single cherry blossoms had fallen here, the double cherry blossoms would be in full bloom there.

units.source_text: 这边八重樱过了盛期，那边山樱方始开花；

en.t: When the double cherry blossoms here had passed their height, the mountain cherries there would just begin to bloom.

units.source_text: 这边山樱开过，那边紫藤花最后发艳。

en.t: After the mountain cherries here had finished blooming, the wisteria there would finally show its splendor.

units.source_text: 这里就不然，紫夫人深谙各种花木的性质，知道它们开花孰早孰迟，巧妙地配置栽植。

en.t: Here it was not so; Lady Murasaki understood the nature of every flowering tree and plant, knew which bloomed early and which late, and arranged the plantings with great skill.

units.source_text: 因此各花按时开放，互相衔接，庭中花香不绝。

en.t: Thus each flower opened in its proper season, following one after another, and the fragrance of blossoms never left the garden.

units.source_text: 三皇子说：“我的樱花开了。

en.t: The Third Prince said, "My cherry blossoms have opened.

units.source_text: 我有一个办法，叫它永远不谢：在树的四周张起帷屏，挂起垂布来，花就不会被风吹落了。”

en.t: I have a way to keep them from ever falling: if we put screens around the tree and hang curtains, the wind will not blow the flowers down."

units.source_text: 他想出了这个好办法，得意地说，样子非常可爱。

en.t: Having thought up this fine idea, he spoke proudly, and looked very endearing.

units.source_text: 源氏笑起来，对他说道：“从前有一个人，想用一个很大很大的衣袖来遮住天空，不让风把花吹落。

en.t: Genji laughed and said to him, "Long ago, someone wanted to cover the sky with a very, very large sleeve so the wind would not blow down the flowers.

units.source_text: 但你想出来的办法比他更好。”

en.t: But the method you have thought of is even better than his."

units.source_text: 他就镇日和三皇子做伴戏耍。

en.t: After that, he spent the whole day keeping the Third Prince company and playing with him.

units.source_text: 有一次他对三皇子说：“我和你做伴，时间也不长久了。

en.t: One time he said to the Third Prince, "The time I can spend with you will not last much longer.

units.source_text: 即使我暂时不死，也不能和你见面。”

en.t: Even if I do not die for the moment, I will no longer be able to see you."

units.source_text: 说罢照例流下泪来。

en.t: When he had said this, he shed tears as usual.

units.source_text: 三皇子听了很不高兴，答道：“外婆说过这种话，外公怎么也说这种不吉祥的话了！”

en.t: The Third Prince was very displeased to hear it and replied, "Grandmother said such things too; why is Grandfather also saying such unlucky things?"

units.source_text: 他垂下眼睛，抚弄着自己的衣袖，借以遮掩眼泪。

en.t: He lowered his eyes and toyed with his own sleeve, using it to hide his tears.
